name: Multi-Resolution Rendering with K-D Tree
definition: A rendering technique using k-d tree nodes to store approximations of data (nodal models) with associated error terms. If the error is below a user-specified threshold, the nodal region is drawn using the approximation; otherwise, traversal continues.
summary: Multi-Resolution Rendering with K-D Tree accelerates volume rendering by storing complete nodal models in a K-D tree, enabling fast previews and adaptive detail based on user-specified error thresholds.
